name: deciles-quartiles
title: Deciles and quartiles of posterior means
idea: Deciles and quartiles of KRW's posterior means sit inside the curve traced by KRW's cards along λ: for each, some card has a lower discordance rate and a higher informativeness.
from: new angle · builds on 3.5 and 5.5; adds deciles and quartiles of KRW's posterior means on KRW's two axes (KRW sections IV.B and V.E, Figures 2C and 6), evaluated with postrank's pair probabilities
credit: After Kline, Rose and Walters (2024), section IV.B (Figure 2C) and section V.E (Figure 6). Firms as adapted in postrank 1.1.0 (pr_case_krw). Cards computed with KRW's code (KRW replication companion) under KRW's archived pair probabilities.
caption: Posterior-mean tiers and archived KRW cards evaluated under the same released signed-target pair probabilities.
